Fadenspieler, Cokwe
Portrait of a woman wearing a headscarf.
Portrait of a man standing, holding a bow and arrow.

View of two mud-brick Chokwe houses with thatched roofs. Painted human figures, animals and geometric patterns decorate the walls of both houses. There is a small group of people the entrance to the house closet to the photographer.
Two Chokwe structures. The thatched structure on the viewer's left is made of grass and a person sits in the entrance. The structure on the viewer's right is made of wooden poles with a grass roof.
Three objects - a comb and two objects that appear to be swords or daggers.
Full length portrait of young girl, seated on ground, wearing bead necklace and metal anklets on both legs.

Three quarter portrait of a young child (girl?) with leather loin cloth, bracelets on the left arm and a necklace of beads with charms. Three quarters of the hairdress (front and upper part) is decorated with dots of clay.
Full portrait of a young girl wrapped in cotton cloth, metal bracelets on the right arm and metal anklets on both legs. Fringe of hair braided.
Half length portrait of a boy, wearing a cord of plantfibres diagonal across chest.

Mother with two Albino (hasa, pl. mahasa) children, a young boy which is standing in front of her, and a baby, which she is carrying on her arm. The mother is wrapped in cotton cloth, the young boy wears a cotton shirt.
Full length portrait of a mother, seated on the ground with a young girl on her lap. The mother has a twisted hairstyle, the end of each strand is covered with dots of clay.
Full length portrait of a female youth, wearing a loin cloth, metal bracelets on both arms and  necklaces of beads. Her hair is twisted.
Three quarter portrait of a young woman with peruke (wiyembe). She wears metal bracelets on both arms and a necklace. Scarification around navel.
Three quarter portrait of a young woman with peruke (wiyembe), wearing loincloth and metal bracelets on both arms; scarifications around navel.
Three quarter portrait of a woman, wearing a peruke (wiyembe), loincloth and metal bracelets on left arm; she is crossing her arms in front of her chest.
Half length portrait of a female youth, wearing a necklace. She is wearing a peruke (wiyembe). Scarifications on right cheek.
Half length portrait of an elderly man with beard, wearing a blankett.
Half length portrait of an elderly man with beard, wearing a blankett.
Half length portrait of a seated man with metal bracelet on his left arm, beard and twisted hairstyle, which covers the backpart of his head.
Half length portrait (profile) of a seated man with beard, whose hairstyle is partly covered with dots of clay (above forehead).
Half length portrait (profile) of a man with beard and scarification from cheek to neck (see 1998.340.22.60).
Head and shoulder portrait of a young male, wearing a europeanlike shirt.
Half length portrait of a standing youth male.
Half length portrait of a middleaged man with beard, trees in background.
Three quarter portrait (profile) of a standing male with metal necklace and bracelet on his right arm, wearing a wooden comb in his hairstyle.

Three quarter portrait of an elderly man in a chequered loincloth with metal bracelet on his left arm, carrying a walking stick and a straw hat in his left hand. Left shoulder is covered with an animal skin.
Seated diviner, throwing objects. The basket ngombo between his legs, a bigger basket at his left side.
Kneeling diviner, called tahi, holding a basket, ngombo, with ritual objects and fur of a wildcat. Another man sitting in the background.
Two men, one of them (left) wearing a hat, talking to each other.
Two women, one of them (sitting on the ground) having her hair done. The woman to the right wears necklaces and metal bracelets on her right arm. Vessel and gourd on the ground.
Man with comb in his hair, styling the hair of a youth sitting in front of him. Hut in the background.
Group of four women and three children, sitting together outside. Bundles of straw in the background.
Group of seven men sitting under the shade of a tree in a village. Huts and storehouses on poles in background.

Group of eleven women, four men and three children. Two women are dancing, whereas the men are playing drums, two of them are standing and playing slit drums, two are sitting and playing the instruments.
Two dancing women wearing metal bracelets on their right arm; men playing slit drums in the background to the right.

Seated man with headdress and beard of plantfibres as well as two bells attached to the big toe of his right foot, playing the instrument tsisazi. Huge gourd as resonance corpus. He is surrounded by boys and men, some standing, some sitting.
Group of ten boys, scene of a circumcision initiation? Six of them are wearing grass skirts, all boys are holding bow and arrow in their hands.

Scene of a circumcision initiation. A group of boys with painted bodies and costumed in grass skirts and headgear are sitting on the ground, surrounded by people of the village. A maskdancer is performing, one man and a boy in the background are playing drums.

Scene of a circumcision initiation, showing six (?) boys in costumes of grass skirt, with painted bodies and headgear (uncannily resembling Portuguese colonial helmet). One man and three boys, who are not costumed, in the background and to the right.

Scene of a circumcision initiation. Group of nine boys, costumed in grass skirts, their body painted and wearing headgear (uncannily resembling Portuguese colonial helmet). An African, dressed in european trousers and shirt with tie, is standing in the background to the left.
Three Europeans with sun helmets in a line, the first with a camera hanging over his shoulder might be Hermann Baumann (?), standing within a grassfield with grown up high grass.
Group portrait of three European children (two boys, one girl) in front of a house. The youngest child is sitting on a stool, stairs of entrance are in the background.

Village's shrine with two (female?) clay figures, partly painted with white dots and stripes. Each has three feathers attached to the head. Signs of libations on stakes in front of shrine, which is made of branches and covered with straw. A small ladder is leaning at the left side of the shrine, which is surrounded by a fence of grass.

Four thatched storage buildings, resting on wooden poles. With one exception the walls are covered with mud, the wall of the smallest storage building is made of a mat. A man is about to enter the third storage building to the right. Two other houses to the left. Basket on the ground, mortar and pestle (?) at the side of the smallest building.
Open-sided shelter. On top of it six tubes made of bark and two birds, one in front of the tubes, one inside of a tube. To the left frame of a house, made of wooden poles.

Shrine.Three bricks made of termite mound earth with traces of libation, at the bottom surrounded by braided ropes. The right bright is flanked by a phalluslike pole. Bricks are standing between wooden poles, which belong partly to the construciton of the shrine. Four smaller poles, which are part of the ritual objects, are painted with white and dark stripes. Thatched wall builts the background.

Square house at the end of an shadowed avenue of large trees. House has thatched roof and mudcovered walls and is flanked at both sides by granaries on wooden poles (two at the right, one at the left side). Tools for Agriculture and Horticulture leaning against the wall.
Three thatched square houses with mudcovered walls beneath large trees. Flat plate made of basketry on roof of the first house to the left.

Group of small squarelike thatched huts with rectangular entrances, delineated to the public path by segmetns of grasmade fence. Shadowed by large trees, broken pottery in front of the hut in the middle.
Ten roof thatched buildings, in front three granaries, resting on wooden poles. The one in the middle is flanked by a man. Mortar (?) on the ground.
Four roof thatched houses, in front a with a fenced-in garden (?) area. Shadowing tree in the foreground to the left.

Five roof thatched houses, the one in front being a storage house resting on wooden poles. Foodstuff or crop drying on mats (?) placed on the roof. Two mortars on the ground besides the granary. Pigeonry on the right side, also with drying stuff on its roof.

Open-sided, roof thatched men's assembly house (tsota) with a group of men and boys; some are sitting outside. The conic roof is resting on wooden poles, a club laying on it. Apex of roof is neatly plaited, thereby showing a pattern of horizontal lines.

Village scene. Thatched houses and open-sided shelters, with groups of peoples sitting in front or beneath. Gourds, vessels and trays made of plants on top of the open-sided shelters. A piece of bark tree is drying on the roof of the first house to the right. Larger village in the background.

Rectangular thatched house with animal shelter in it's front. Woman carrying a child on her left hip stands to the left. Behind her there is a thatched hut, covered with tree trunks. Mortar on the right side of the entrance.
Roof thatched mud building with designs painted on the outside, showing human beings dressed in masquerade costumes and birds.
Roof thatched mud building with designs painted on the outside, showing graphic designs and a masquerade costume (see 1998.340.22.189).
